run_cluster_pdb_val_mmcifs: run the AlphaFold 3 PDB validation dataset clustering pipeline via argparse CLI with mmCIF input and output directories
filter_to_low_homology_sequences: filter PDB chain sequences to retain only low homology polymers and novel ligands against a reference training set
cluster_sequences_using_mmseqs2: cluster protein, nucleic acid, and peptide sequences by MMseqs2 at configurable sequence identity thresholds
cluster_interfaces: cluster multimeric interfaces by combining the cluster IDs of the two interacting chains
subsample_interface_clusters: subsample interface clusters by type with configurable per-type limits for protein-protein, protein-ligand, and other interface categories
